notes.title: Status update
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We know many of you eagerly await news about the next patch and a plan for the following updates. We're sorry to hear that Yacht Mechanic Simulator failed to meet expectations. We, as a publisher, humbly apologize for letting this happen. Going forward, we must do better and we will do better.

Sadly, we don't have any good news to share at the moment. To this day, we have only received one functional patch from the dev team and it surely didn't fix all of the issues you face. Since the last patch went live, the developer didn't share with us any information regarding the scale of the next patch and we didn't receive any ETA for it either. Because of this, we, sadly, can't answer your questions regarding the contents or the release date of the next patch - we don't have this information either. 

We didn't inform you of the delay in new patches because we expected them to roll out faster. But it's nearly a month after the release, and we owe you sincere and clear communication. So, here it is.

That said, we are trying to get things settled with the developer so that you don't have to wait for the patch any longer. Simultaneously, we're looking into other solutions.

We want Yacht Mechanic Simulator to be in a state that you, the players, will deem acceptable. We're doing what we can for you to receive the support you deserve. But this might still take some time, depending on how the current situation evolves. 

Hopefully, more patches will start rolling out soon. We are dedicated to improving this game and we'll keep looking for a solution to your problems for as long as it takes. Until then, thank you for your patience.

Best 
Image Power team

notes.title: Hotfix 1 now available!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Here’s the first promised hotfix for YMS! We know that the game requires many more patches, and this is only the first step. More info on upcoming patches soon!

Here’s what’s fixed:


 Blockers at the beginning of the game

 Brush losing focus from the stain, it is now possible to remove the dirt

  While unscrewing the boat elements they are no longer blocked

 Loadinfinisjing in-game orders no longer causes errors

 After unlocking a new stage, the order list is no longer missing

 Magenta floor

 Too high saturation on the dirt texture is now fixed.

 Some items (in store, in different categories) without translations 

 The first-person camera no longer "eats" pieces of the boat while looking around

 After you start e.g. loosening screws, the FOV is now changed

 Sliders in sound settings corrected


Also we have  added the following fixes:


 COLORFUL lettering of the tool to be used. The green inscription will clearly emphasize the tool to be used

 Changed sound effects during teak renovation

 Tutorial windows are less transparent which makes is easily readable

 Auto-save after completing the tutorial


If any of the above is not working for you, please let us know here (also if you experienced any new bugs and glitches) : https://steamcommunity.com/app/1263620/discussions/1/

We appreciate your support!

Punch Punk Games/Image Power (publisher)

notes.title: Important community update
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

It’s Yacht’s main producer here. Day 1 was quite tough. We started with a positive attitude while launching the game but pretty soon it came clear that some things didn’t go well.

First of all, I’m sorry that we didn’t deliver the top quality on launch. We are a small team and it is safe to say that we were too confident with development process/testing. We tried to do our best but that doesn’t always work, right? We owe you an explanation and apologize to those of you who experienced serious issues with the game. 

It seems that at least some of you experienced and are still experiencing major issues with our game. We are now focused on patching YMS. We are now compelling the list of crucial bugs, and soon we will enter the phase of fixing. That said:

You may expect patches coming your way. We are now working hard to deliver it as soon as possible. I want it to be properly tested and solid. This is our responsibility and we treat it very, very seriously. We owe you that and we fully recognize this fact.

With that said, I wanted to thank everyone who willingly contributed to our game. It is priceless that some folks spent their time talking to us and reporting to us. We are in your debt!!! And to all of you who play and enjoy the game, we are also so happy to see it.

We humbly accept negatives  – we don’t blame anyone but ourselves. If you however like the game and you haven’t experienced any serious issues – your positive review would mean the world to us now. It would make our current work more meaningful. 

Last but not least, please use this Steam forum thread if you want to report any technical/gameplay bugs: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1263620/discussions/1/3453716250587111209/  

Thank you for your support!

Punch Punk Games (dev) & Image Power (publisher)

notes.title: Devlog update & new gameplay
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

In case you missed the most important news…  🛥️Yacht Mechanic Simulator will be released on Steam on the 28th of July.🛥️ We are now constantly present here on Steam forums, so should you have any questions, just let us know here or on our official Discord! 

As for now, we are mostly working on polishing the game and making sure it is released without any bigger flaws. You may check how the game looks now, just watch the short gameplay we have grabbed for you lately.

[previewyoutube=kfxvTlPkuvU;full][/previewyoutube]

We have recently implemented all the crucial mechanics and elements of gameplay, and we are now mostly tweaking it, ensuring everything works flawlessly for the release date:). Actually, this Thursday we will have a huge cross-team meeting (Punch Punk devteam and Image Power publishing team) to schedule next steps prior to the release of the game. 

There are of course significant changes, especially if you compare our current build with the old demo of the game. We have added a few mini-games, among them the Workshop table, cleaning of the teak deck, repairing hull holes, etc. We have also completely reworked a tutorial of the game to make the Yacht Mechanic Simulator easier to access. So, if you checked the old demo you will most definitely feel familiar, but the gameplay was significantly improved and expanded. 

We have also added stuff like painting your yacht or customizing your boat with a set of decal stickers. You may see it in the clip above but also in the last trailer:

[previewyoutube=_zZtMM6jtzM;full][/previewyoutube]
